description: This file defines utility functions and paths related to environment variables, configuration files, and directories used by the OpenClaw application. It provides methods to retrieve environment variables, determine the configuration file URL, and locate the workspace directory.

methods.name: OpenClawEnv.path
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable, trims whitespace, and returns it if non-empty.

methods.name: OpenClawPaths.stateDirURL
methods.description: Computes the URL for the application's state directory, prioritizing environment overrides.

methods.name: OpenClawPaths.resolveConfigCandidate
methods.description: Checks if a configuration file exists in a given directory; returns its URL if found.

methods.name: OpenClawPaths.configURL
methods.description: Determines the URL of the configuration file, considering environment overrides and default locations.

methods.name: OpenClawPaths.workspaceURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the workspace directory within the state directory.
